responsibility: This file implements the RTL lower-subreg passes that decompose profitable multiword pseudo-register SUBREG uses into word-sized pseudos and operations. It analyzes which pseudos appear only in decomposable contexts, computes target-specific profitability for splitting wide moves, shifts, and zero-extends, rewrites insns and notes to use decomposed subwords, and repairs CFG when split trapping loads create new control-flow boundaries. Its responsibility is structural lowering of wide pseudo-register operations to improve CSE and register allocation, not general subreg simplification for all RTL.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/lower-subreg.h, which just defines the target_lower_subreg cost/choice structures and globals describing what kinds of splitting are profitable, this file performs the actual RTL analysis and rewriting passes that decompose wide SUBREG-based pseudos and repair CFG as needed.
